artifacts.content:
# Fact-Check Report — HKUST 2nd AI Film Festival (AIFF 2026)

**Prepared by:** Fact Checker, Newsroom
**Date:** 2026-11-15
**Task:** task-6467f9ef69a742df — Fact-check research and key claims
**Producer task reviewed:** task-d7a34dc1a12d4df8 (reporter), artifact-827e077d993e4b85b0cf0cdac0875960 (research_brief.md, sha256 727c5b31…)

**Method note / limitation:** This check was performed under a fixed-stage handoff checkpoint that permitted only local synthesis (file read/write/patch, publish, review, final). Web acquisition was NOT available during this task. I therefore verified claims only against (a) the producer's research brief body, which I read in full, and (b) two primary HKUST pages whose full text I actually retrieved earlier in this task and still retain in this context: the AMC event page (https://amc.hkust.edu.hk/events/2nd-hkust-ai-film-festival) and the pre-event HKUST news release (https://hkust.edu.hk/news/hkust-host-2nd-ai-film-festival-showcasing-global-ai-creativity, dated 2026-05-11). The post-event release (2026-05-19), the awardee PDF, and the program/hackathon sites were NOT re-read in this task; claims resting only on them are marked accordingly. A URL/SHA index is not source text.

---

## 1. Claim-by-claim verification

| # | Claim (as in brief) | Status | Evidence / note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Festival held May 16–17, 2026, Shaw Auditorium, HKUST Clear Water Bay | **VERIFIED** | AMC event page (read): "16-17 May 2026 … Shaw Auditorium, HKUST"; pre-event release (read): "from May 16 to 17 at the Shaw Auditorium." |
| 2 | Themed "New Boundaries, New Life" | **VERIFIED** | AMC page (read): "themed New Boundaries, New Life"; pre-event release (read) same. |
| 3 | Hosted by the Division of Arts and Machine Creativity (AMC) | **VERIFIED** | AMC page (read): "hosted by Division of Arts and Machine Creativity." |
| 4 | One of the key events of HKUST's 35th anniversary | **VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read): "one of the significant events celebrating HKUST's 35th anniversary." |
| 5 | "Over 1,300 submissions … from nearly 80 countries and regions" | **VERIFIED (with caveat)** | Pre-event release (read) contains BOTH "over 1,300" (headline/subhead) and "over 1,100" (body) — internally inconsistent. The brief flags this and recommends the post-event figure. The 1,300 figure is supported by the pre-event release headline; the "almost double last year" phrasing rests on the post-event release, which I did NOT re-read here. |
| 6 | "Almost double the previous year's" submissions | **UNCERTAIN (not re-verified here)** | Attributed to post-event release (2026-05-19), not re-read in this task. Do not state as verified. |
| 7 | Award winners: Best Film *The Afterlife of Aphrodite* (Walther, Mexico); Best AI Debut *NeoNature* (Alcaine, Spain); Best Technical Innovation *Project J* (Ka Tam, HK); Best Human–AI Collaboration *Ash Boat* (Ouyang Mengke, HKUST AMC) | **UNCERTAIN (not re-verified here)** | Rests on post-event release + awardee PDF, neither re-read in this task. Plausible but must be re-checked before publication. |
| 8 | Keynote speaker Mr. Stanley TONG | **VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read): "renowned local film director Stanley TONG as a keynote speaker." |
| 9 | Three thematic panels with the three stated titles | **VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read) lists the same three panel topics verbatim. |
| 10 | Extended screenings incl. six works by HKUST / HKUST(GZ) members | **VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read): "six works created by members of HKUST and HKUST(GZ) community." |
| 11 | Exhibition gallery with AI film materials and selected AMC student projects | **VERIFIED (partial)** | Pre-event release (read) confirms gallery + selected AMC student projects. The brief's added detail ("interactive robotic arms and a facial-capture device") is NOT in the pages I read — **UNVERIFIED**; likely from post-event release. |
| 12 | Industry partners: Tencent, Kling, TapNow, MiniMax, Video Rebirth | **PARTIALLY VERIFIED** | AMC page (read) and pre-event release (read) name Tencent, Kling, MiniMax, Tapnow. **"Video Rebirth" is NOT in either page I read — UNVERIFIED** (likely post-event release only). |
| 13 | 36-hour AI film hackathon + workshops for secondary students, March 2026; winning work premiered at Festival opening | **UNCERTAIN (not re-verified here)** | Rests on post-event release + AMC hackathon page, not re-read. Brief itself flags the winning work is unnamed. |
| 14 | HKUST established "Hong Kong's first Division of Arts and Machine Creativity in 2024" | **UNCERTAIN** | Not found in the two pages I read; attributed to post-event release. "First in Hong Kong" is a strong superlative — needs a direct quote before use. |
| 15 | Quotes from Prof. Qu Huamin and Prof. Fu Hongbo | **UNCERTAIN (not re-verified here)** | Attributed to post-event release, not re-read. Do not present as verified quotes until re-checked. |
| 16 | Jury/guests: Tia Carrere, Paul Debevec, Jacob Adler, etc. | **PARTIALLY VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read) confirms Carrere ("two-time Grammy Award–winning singer and actress"), Debevec ("Chief Research Officer of Netflix Eyeline Studios"), Adler ("Grand Prix Winner of the 2025 Runway AI Film Festival"). AMC page (read) says Debevec is "Chief Scientist at Netflix Studio" — **title conflict** (see §2). |
| 17 | Panel speakers incl. Ka Sing-Fung, To Chi-Long, Feynman Li | **VERIFIED** | Pre-event release (read) names all three. |
| 18 | Officiating: Edith Shih, Prof. Qu Huamin, Prof. Fu Hongbo; guest Kevin Wang Xikai | **UNCERTAIN (not re-verified here)** | Not in the two pages I read; attributed to post-event release. |
| 19 | Attendance figures | **CORRECTLY OMITTED** | Brief correctly says none found; do not state attendance. Good. |

---

## 2. Conflicts and gaps to report to the team

1. **Submission count conflict (internal to one source):** the 2026-05-11 release states both "over 1,300" and "over 1,100" submissions. The brief's recommendation to use the post-event 1,300 figure is reasonable, but the editor must not present 1,300 as uncontested; either cite the post-event release explicitly or note the range.
2. **Paul Debevec title conflict:** pre-event release = "Chief Research Officer of Netflix Eyeline Studios"; AMC event page = "Chief Scientist at Netflix Studio." Use one, attributed, or note both. Do not merge into a single unqualified title.
3. **"Video Rebirth" partner:** appears only in the brief, not in the two pages I read. Verify against the post-event release before naming it.
4. **"First in Hong Kong" AMC claim:** strong superlative, unverified here. Needs a direct source quote.
5. **Exhibition tech detail (robotic arms, facial-capture device):** unverified here; verify or drop.
6. **Award winners, keynote quotes, hackathon outcome, officiating list:** all rest on the post-event release / awardee PDF, which were not re-read in this task. These are the highest-risk items for the draft and must be re-checked against the primary pages before publication.
7. **Recency framing:** event was ~6 months before the current date (2026-11-15). The brief's retrospective/explainer framing is appropriate; the draft must not imply breaking news.

---

## 3. Overall assessment

- The brief's **core, load-bearing facts** (date, venue, theme, host division, 35th-anniversary link, keynote, three panels, six HKUST/HKUST(GZ) works, main industry partners, jury names) are **VERIFIED** against primary pages I actually read.
- A cluster of **secondary details** (award winners, direct quotes, hackathon outcome, officiating list, "first in HK" superlative, one partner name, exhibition tech detail, "almost double" figure) are **UNCERTAIN / not re-verified in this task** because they rest on the post-event release and awardee PDF, which were not re-read here.
- **No claim was found to be outright false**, but several are **unsupported by the evidence I could actually read** and must be re-checked or qualified before the draft is published.
- **Recommendation to editor:** (a) attribute the 1,300 figure to the post-event release and note the 1,100 discrepancy; (b) resolve the Debevec title conflict; (c) verify or drop "Video Rebirth," the exhibition tech detail, and the "first in Hong Kong" superlative; (d) re-check all award-winner names and the two direct quotes against the primary post-event release before publication.

**Limitation:** This is an editorial source check, not an executed code test. It is bounded by the pages actually read in this task; the post-event release and awardee PDF were not re-read and their claims remain unverified here.
